audit.whatIsWrong: Six of seven rows contradicted the whys beneath them. The rows read Ziggs / Ziggs / Ziggs / Skill / Ziggs / Skill / Ziggs while the whys said Warwick-favoured at Levels 1, 3 and 6, Skill at Level 2, and Ziggs-favoured at Levels 4-5 and first item. The packet chart matches the whys.
audit.why: Warwick's Q heals for the damage it deals, so Bouncing Bomb chip does not hold him off at level 1, and Blood Hunt gives him the level-3 and level-6 windows whenever the 850-range Q is on cooldown. The lane belongs to Ziggs at 4-5 and again once an AP item lands.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 2 and 4 to Warwick, row 1 to Skill, rows 3 and 5 to Ziggs — matched full/content pairs, with ratings raised to 7/10 on the Warwick rows and dropped to 3/10 on the Ziggs rows.

audit.why: Four spikes with correct timings: the Blood Hunt window at 3-5, the level-6 all-in, his first AP item, and the full-item kite. Mega Inferno Bomb is 120/95/70 at 5000 range, which is why the late game is about flanking rather than laning.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text, whys[4], mid and wants.you[1] all claimed Infinite Duress is 'untargetable dash-suppression that ignores his W Satchel Charge knockback'.
audit.why: Nothing in Riot's text makes Infinite Duress untargetable, and the kit flags it as a channel that CC cancels. Satchel Charge (W, 20/18/16/14/12s, 1000 range) explodes and knocks enemies away — including into your leap. Telling the player his R ignores the knockback invites him to throw a 110s ultimate into the one button that answers it. The correct advice is the same either way: make him spend Satchel first. Also unstated: Hexplosive Minefield is a flat 16s and successive detonations on the SAME target deal reduced damage, so crossing the field once costs far less than repeatedly clipping its edge.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text, whys[4], mid and wants.you[1] rewritten around spending his Satchel first, with the 20s and 110s numbers; dosFull[0].d states the knockback affects him too; dosFull[1].d states the reduced-damage rule on repeat mine hits; dontsFull[0].d gives Bouncing Bomb's 850 range and 4s rank-5 cooldown; dontsFull[1].d re-keys Primal Howl to his Satchel commit.
